اصطلقوا (form VIII)
# اِصْطَلَقُوا (iṣṭalaqū) /isˤ.tˤa.la.quː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِصْطَلَقَ (iṣṭalaqa)
# اُصْطُلِقُوا (uṣṭuliqū) /usˤ.tˤu.li.quː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِصْطَلَقَ (iṣṭalaqa)
# اِصْطَلِقُوا (iṣṭaliqū) /isˤ.tˤa.li.quː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِصْطَلَقَ (iṣṭalaqa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
